citation.source: Convergent egg-composition sources (e.g. university food-science lecture notes; commonly-tabulated egg-component-percentage figures widely reproduced in baking/food-science references): shell ~10-12% of a whole large egg's mass, egg white ~57-58%, egg yolk ~30-33% — the three figures roughly sum to 100%, corroborating each other.
citation.note: Multiple convergent secondary/tertiary sources checked 2026-08-16, not one single peer-reviewed primary source looked up directly — same tier as several other percentage-composition citations in this repo. See egg_yolk.json/egg_white.json for the matching complementary figures, and egg_cracked.json for the derived shell-complement figure.

metadata.notes: The one byproduct common to both of egg.json's spawning actions — PEEL (shell off a boiled egg) and SEPARATE (cracking a raw egg) — hence it's egg.json's flat producedByproducts fallback, with byproductsByAction only overriding SEPARATE to add egg_yolk + egg_white on top. Unlike potato_peel.json, marked non-reusable: no fry/mix-equivalent reuse path modeled for it.
